motion planning
Carlos Ortiz∗, Adriana Lara†, Jesu´s Gonz´alez‡, and Ayse Borat
Abstract
We describe and implement a randomized algorithm that inputs a polyhe-
dron, thought of as the space of states of some automated guided vehicle R,
and outputs an explicit system of piecewise linear motion planners for R. The
algorithm is designed in such a way that thecardinality of the outputed system
is probabilistically close (with parameters chosen by the user) to minimal pos-
sible.

planning in terms of simplicial complexity (SC) techniques, a discretization of
Farber’s topological complexity TC.
